notes.title: Catalyst – Closed-Beta announcement!
notes.notes:
"Catalyst is an interactive story and it's like reading a Creepypasta story, but also it's not. One major difference is your influence in regards of the ending of the story."

Hi everyone, we finally reached that joyful moment when we have a build ready to share with a few good-hearted testers. Indeed, today we officially start our closed-Beta testing session. 

Closed Beta will give us invaluable information and insight into how our game plays out. 

From experience we believe the beta testing phase should take one or two weeks. ( The build has already been vigorously tested in-house. )

We'll keep you posted on our upcoming release date!
